what_happened: Compile-verified the whole repair end to end during research rather than deferring to implementation: mkAppOptM repair, both observing? call-site moves, three modal_search acceptance examples, full lake build and lake test all measured green with zero warnings, plus a counterfactual build confirming the acceptance test is red pre-repair. The plan can be written against measured facts, not candidates.

Moving the buildContextExpr call inside observing? carries its explanatory comment with it, leaving a bare blank line before 'let success' that trips Mathlib's linter.style.emptyLines ('do not place empty lines within commands') at Search.lean:473 and :525. Invisible to review; only a compiled build surfaced it. The repair must also delete those two blank lines to meet the zero-warning gate.

LemmaDBTest.lean's module header claims TacticsTest.lean 'has pre-existing errors from the frame-class generalization'. Measured baseline: lake build BimodalTest is green with zero errors and zero warnings, so that claim is stale. Not this task's scope to fix, but it should not be cited as a live constraint.

Research verified the repair green via lake build/lake test but never staged a commit, so the .githooks/pre-commit typst count gate went unexercised. Planner found that Search.lean loses two blank lines (620 -> 618), moving typst/generated/status.typ's formalsystem-line-count, and the new test block moves tests-line-count; FormalSystem/Automation/Tactics/README.md's generated block also carries Search.lean's raw line count. Both regenerations are now scheduled as named phase work in the same phase as the Lean edits, per the lean4 plan-authoring-gate-collisions Condition 1.

The research report carried a 13-row compiled verification record including a counterfactual red build, so the plan needed no re-derivation of the repair choice, the observing? placement ruling, the blank-line linter collision, or the exact test bodies. Planning reduced to scheduling plus the one gate collision research could not have hit without committing.

Plan's Scope Hypothesis enumerated two drifting generated surfaces (typst/generated/status.typ, FormalSystem/Automation/Tactics/README.md); a third drifted: typst/generated/automation-module-map.typ, whose Tactics/Search.lean row (620->618) and automation-module-total (3345->3343) both moved. typst-sync-check.sh --fix does NOT repair it (Check 2b is read-only); scripts/typst-module-map.sh is its own regenerator. Regenerated and staged per the plan's confirm-by-running instruction.

verify-touched.sh derived 12 touched paths including specs/TODO.md, specs/state.json and specs/events.jsonl (other sessions' uncommitted changes on this shared tree), which pulled in the whole agent-system test battery rather than the Lean suites. 11 of 95 suites failed, all in .claude/scripts/tests/**, all because agent-system/extensions does not exist in this repository (deploy-only tree, source store elsewhere) -- e.g. test-generate-task-order.sh: 'generate-task-order.sh not found (mode=source-store)'. None of the six files this phase edits is read by any failing suite, so these are pre-existing baseline findings outside this phase's file scope, recorded as enumerated PASS per the plan's delta-not-absolute-zero criterion.

Research had measured the entire change green end to end and had recorded the exact probe body and acceptance examples verbatim in the report, plus the two blank-line linter findings the relocation would produce. Implementation was therefore transcription plus verification: zero build iterations, zero failed tactic attempts, first scoped build green with zero warnings, first full build and lake test both green with zero warnings. Measured effort ~20 minutes against a 1.25-hour estimate.
